comment: Remix draw classification (dxvk-remix @0867d3c, d3d9_rtx.cpp makeDrawCallType / rtx_types.cpp heuristics) expected for the app's sidecar tags.
Per tag: one expectation for every draw with that tag in a recorded frame, or a list applied to the tag's draws in order (the last entry repeats).
Fields: status (ignored|rasterized|raytraced), reason (ClassifyReason), inject, sky_auto, using_rt_rt, drawing_to_rt_rt, categories (exact '|' list, '' = none), categories_include.
Conf placeholders: {upload:K} = Remix hash of the K-th texture uploaded (level 0), {rtdesc:K} = descriptor hash of the K-th render-target texture.

hud.why: isRenderingUI needs PROJECTION[3][3] == 1 AND ZWRITEENABLE off; the app leaves ZWRITEENABLE on (only ZENABLE off), so Remix ray traces the ortho HUD

configs.name: ui_texture
configs.comment: The HUD icon texture also textures the three world cubes: the first cube becomes the injection point and everything after it is rasterized (Remix: the first UI draw triggers injection).

configs.name: sky_auto_depth_flags
configs.comment: One camera per frame (sky and world share VIEW; the HUD's VIEW is identity), so checkSkyAutoDetect uses its fallback for frames without two cameras: depth test off = sky. The ortho HUD runs with ZENABLE off and is auto-detected as sky too.
